versions.changelog: Major update: covers all 9 MCP tools, adds YAML frontmatter, query tips, category filters, structured extraction, deep research, token efficiency

- Improved SKILL.md formatting with clearer section headings and code blocks.

- Streamlined descriptions and input details for easier understanding.

- No changes to code or functional aspects.

- Initial release of web-search-exa skill with Exa MCP integration.

- Enables real-time public web search for up-to-date sources and content summaries.

- Supports customizable search options: result count, search type (auto, fast, deep), live crawl preference, and context size limit.

- Provides example queries and usage scenarios for fact checking, research, and content extraction.

- No API key required; simple MCP server connection setup. Super easy to setup.
